prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 40s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other — wearing a skin-tight glossy cherry-red PVC catsuit with long sleeves and matching PVC gloves, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the PVC fully covering her bust, stretched over every curve from neck to ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the elbows and knees, completely opaque, the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, and a seamless cherry-red PVC hood covering her whole head, face and neck with mirror shine, closed by a zipper at the back, with three openings cut in the PVC: two almond-shaped openings around her eyes, a small opening for her nose and one around her lips. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring and her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each of the four rings linked by a thick chain of massive black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, to its own huge rough-cast black iron ball as big as an oil drum that rests on the flagstones beside that limb, the four chains pulled taut, the weight dragging her arms down and her legs wide apart. Pose: standing with her legs wide apart, facing the camera, her arms dragged straight down and slightly out by the chains, her shoulders pulled low, her head bowed slightly, her bare feet flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Wear: The suit is dulled with dust and soot smears across her chest, thighs and sleeves, sweat beads and runs on the polish, and the gloves are streaked black on the backs of her hands. Dust clings around the openings at her eyes and her lips are dry and a little cracked, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.
Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy cherry-red PVC with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is wrapped in the glossy PVC hood, only her eyes, nose and lips showing through their openings — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a hint of quiet misery, her brows tilted up slightly at the inner ends and her lips pressed together, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her feet to the top of her head completely visible, the chamber around her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
